writing1.title: Writing 1 · Data description
writing1.prompt: The chart shows the number of students following a school media-awareness page over four weeks: 45, 62, 78 and 86. Describe the trend, compare the values and suggest a reason for the increase. Write at least 100 words.

chart.title: Students following a school media-awareness page

teacherKeyFacts: Total increase from first to last week is 41.
Largest rise is between Weeks 1 and 2 (17).
writing1.grading: five-level teacher rubric, no automatic writing grade

writing2.title: Writing 2 · Formal email
writing2.prompt: Write a formal email to your school principal proposing a campaign about responsible social-media influence. Explain how students can check claims made by influencers and how the campaign will benefit the school. Write at least 100 words.
writing2.grading: five-level teacher rubric, no automatic writing grade
